milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the cyan wall banner (mounted on a fence post at spawn-relative ~4, ~3, ~0) and face toward it, modeling that they can visually observe and identify it. The banner is only ~4 blocks from spawn so max_distance=10 is generous, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is genuinely looking at the banner rather than passing by with their back turned.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the acacia door (at spawn-relative ~11, ~1, ~3 on the building's south-facing wall) and face toward it, confirming they have located and can observe the door. Max distance of 8 blocks requires closer approach to clearly identify the distinctive orange-brown acacia wood type, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the door.
